breadth_condition: Seven-day base case: proxy breadth remains weak and broad altseason stays inactive. This call is invalidated only if altcoin outperformance versus BTC broadens beyond isolated leaders, transmits into midcaps, and persists through pullbacks.
ethbtc_condition: Seven-day base case: ETH leadership remains unconfirmed. Persistence above 0.03 is constructive but insufficient by itself; confirmation requires sustained ETH-relative strength accompanied by broader alt/BTC transmission.
structural_calls: The market remains in downside-sensitive consolidation rather than broad risk expansion over the seven-day horizon.
BTC remains the relative structural anchor.
ETH does not establish sustained, broadly transmitted leadership during the week.
Proxy breadth remains weak and broad altseason does not activate.
Rotation remains selective and does not develop into sustained midcap, small-cap, and microcap transmission.
Recent BTC/ETH deleveraging and positive settled ETF totals cushion conditions but do not independently trigger broad expansion.
